name: iter20_schedules_i3n50
description: WEAK-INITIAL-MODEL variant of iter20_schedules: dynamic (sigma widens, alpha decays), but the initial model is trained for only 3 iterations on 50 points instead of 12 on 100. The premise is that a weaker starting model leaves a larger, longer-lived deficit, so guidance has something real to aim at for more than one round. Read the absolute MAE alongside the gap: a worse initial model raises the error scale, so a constant RELATIVE advantage shows up as a larger absolute gap without the method having improved. 20 iterations, 15 seeds, new-only regime.
